intro: One playthrough can earn all 55 trophies. GTA VI has no mission replay and no New Game Plus (Output Lag's launch coverage), so the roadmap is built around two habits: keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — the game offers 15 manual save slots plus an autosave — and never use cheats on your trophy save, since cheats are reported to disable trophies and saving (GTA Vibes, Output Lag). There are no online trophies and no difficulty trophies: the platinum is long, not hard. Published estimates put it near 200 hours; treat that as an estimate, not a promise.

missables.name: Positive Mental Attitude
missables.why: One of its 18 meditation spots — Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — exists only during Chapter 1 and is gone once the chapter ends. Launch coverage (Output Lag, GTA Vibes) flags this as the list's one missable risk; whether the trophy strictly requires that spot is unconfirmed, so do the meditation in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

missables.name: Strangers & Freaks (one step)
missables.why: Not missable as a trophy, but one strand step is time-sensitive: the Chapter 3 street race in Yago's strand (flagged with an hourglass in Output Lag's coverage). Run stranger races the moment they appear; the strand counts toward the 8 this silver needs.

missables.name: Everything else
missables.why: No other trophy is reported missable. Story trophies are unmissable by construction, side-story finales stay open after the credits, and every activity, collectible and robbery can be done in free roam. The real risk in this list is not a missed trophy — it is a wasted playthrough, which the chapter-save habit prevents.

stages.name: Set up, then Chapter 1
stages.text: Before anything else: turn autosave discipline into slot discipline — one manual save at the start of Chapter 1, kept untouched. Play the opening through Gone Fishing and finish Chapter 1. Inside this chapter sits the run's one missable beat: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house, which counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears when the chapter ends. Do it before you finish the chapter, and keep that Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

stages.name: Chapter 2 — Leonida becomes a two-hander
stages.text: Finish Breakfast Run: character switching opens right after it, and with it the partner trophies. Call your partner in and bank Hot Together and Retail Therapy while the map is fresh. Buy the 8 garages through the Vice City Real Estate app (unlocked after Daily Driver) and start registering cars in the Scooter Bros app (opened by the mission Moses) — garage space is the bottleneck for On the Spot. Rob Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates operation, for Let's Go Bowling, and sample every new activity icon once for Master of None.

stages.name: Chapters 3–4 — the money opens up
stages.text: The robbery suite unlocks here: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 hands you the Snap Gun (Sneakthief), and the optional That's Where The Money Is late in Chapter 4 opens the bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal, with Hot Together riding along). Rob one illegal operation per gang as you meet them (Pest Control) and launder every marked bill promptly (Dime on the Dollar). Watch for the time-sensitive stranger race in Chapter 3 — run it the moment it appears. In parallel, start the Shooting Range golds (The Shootist) and one Top Fun win per location while the activities are new.

stages.name: Chapter 5 — the finale
stages.text: Keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission, then finish the story for the gold You Gotta Know When to Get Off. Everything outside the story — side strands, collectibles, the 100% checklist — stays available after the credits, so nothing in the later stages needs to be rushed into this one.

stages.name: Post-story — finish every strand
stages.text: Close out the stranger strands: the finales for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each carry their own bronze, and Bret's hunting strand ends in Fair Game. Then complete 8 counting strands for Strangers & Freaks — remembering that the strands with their own trophies do not advance that counter, so check it after each finale. Finish Cal's fishing challenge (Baited My Tackle) while you tour the map.

stages.name: The open-world sweep
stages.text: Now the counted grinds, most of which stack on the same habits: WAiNK everything (You WAiNKer!, Whip It Good), meditate at every remaining spot (Positive Mental Attitude), reveal all 52 areas (The Goodtime State), complete 3 card sets (Don't Touch My Deck), push Challenges past 50 (One Last Thing) and stunts past 250 (Cunning Stunts). Take the VCIA jet (Catch Me If You Can) and the Mile Zero tank (Challenging Tank) on the same southwest trip. The cryptic hidden trophies (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Personal Best, Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) are worked from their official descriptions — each guide in this app says plainly which of their triggers are still unconfirmed.

stages.name: 100% — and the platinum
stages.text: A Long Road is the last long pole: the game's own checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) asks for more than the trophies in several places — 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 vaults, all 39 gang operations. Work the checklist itself, not the trophy list, in this stage. When it hits 100%, the gold pops — and with every other trophy already earned, Vice Got a Price! follows immediately.

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
